mutants.label: month-window-previous-30-days
mutants.why: the month's artifact is the one of the same CALENDAR month, not any retrain in the previous 30 days: 03-03 must not reuse the 02-10 booster

mutants.label: month-key-ignores-year
mutants.replace: "where extract(month from retrained_on) = month(?) and retrained_on <= ? "
mutants.why: keying the month on its number alone lets a booster of last year's same month govern

mutants.label: own-artifact-excluded-by-strict-upper-bound
mutants.why: a rerun after a crash between persist and append must find its own date's artifact

mutants.label: orphan-artifact-governs-later-date
mutants.why: an artifact of a never-issued date must be ignored: the month retrains at its first ISSUED date

mutants.label: retrain-closed-bound-inclusive
mutants.why: a pair closing exactly at runtime_utc is not in that night's fit (strict <); n_history_rows must not count it

mutants.label: history-cutoff-inclusive
mutants.why: a pair closing exactly at artifact.cutoff_utc belongs to the delta, not the restored history (double count)

mutants.label: history-bounded-at-run-time-not-cutoff
mutants.why: restore night must rebuild history as of the retrain, else the delta is applied twice

mutants.label: delta-has-no-lower-bound
mutants.why: the delta must be bounded below by the artifact cutoff (bounded load)

mutants.label: adapter-cutoff-filter-removed
mutants.why: a run row that closed before the artifact cutoff is already in the restored history; update must not take it again -- equivalent in the log: a run row already closed before the artifact cutoff is, by the late rule, always rejected (window_end <= now), and a duplicated pair can only shift its own group, whose single night row it is; the filter is defence in depth

mutants.label: run-date-rows-not-excluded-from-closed
mutants.why: the run date's own closed pair arrives with the run rows; it must be seen once

mutants.label: baseline-bound-too-narrow
mutants.why: bounded load must still cover the whole 30-day window

mutants.label: baseline-bound-inclusive
mutants.why: fit keeps window_end > anchor - 30d strictly; reading the boundary pair loads more than the window

mutants.label: baseline-anchor-inclusive
mutants.why: the anchor is the last close strictly before T; a pair closing at T shifts the 30-day bound later

mutants.label: baseline-anchor-ignores-scorable
mutants.why: the anchor is the last SCORABLE close; an unscorable later close shifts the bound

mutants.label: baseline-first-night-no-history-crash
mutants.find:
if anchor is None:
        closed = run_rows.clear()
mutants.why: a first night with no closed pair has no anchor: baseline falls back to raw

mutants.why: a silent group keeps its last 7 pairs however old
